messages.author: Todd Minehardt
messages.body:
Abdelatif,
As Professor Case and others have stated (if I might be allowed some
editorial leeway), you keep sending in lengthy copypasta containing nothing
but error messages: this is not an effective way for you to get assistance.
It is painfully obvious that parmed is either not installed on your machine
or installed in a place not included in your PATH environment variable; and
your python distribution is 3.12, which is not going to fly.
Finally, have you actually added a line to your .bashrc to source amber.sh?
It looks to me like you haven't.
Unfortunately, until you make some progress on the self-help issues, your
installation will remain broken and that precludes doing anything, much
less a tutorial.
Cheers,
Todd
